message.content: Next item. Someone will suggest replacing src/parser with the upstream parsekit package. The answer is no: the vendored parser stays vendored, permanently. We patched it for POSIX sh and a registry dependency would drag a node toolchain into a shell tool. Nothing in the repository says this anywhere.

content.text: Understood: src/parser/ must never become a registry dependency, and the reason is the POSIX-sh patch plus the toolchain it would pull in.
